_comment: Worked example of the `editorial` field specified in docs/EXTRACTOR_OUTPUT.md. Every claim and URL below was returned by the live Cala API (knowledge/search for the evidenced path, knowledge/query for the rest). Nothing here is invented. Use it to design and build the front end before the extractor exists.

structure._why_partial: Ownership is known but came from knowledge/query, which returns no document URLs. Rule 4 of the structure route says a chapter is only `evidenced` with a public URL. This is what `partial` looks like — design for it, it will be common until the enrichment pass lands.
